stdout:
Delete live streams. Use this tool to delete live streams by their IDs.

Usage:
  yutu liveStream delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a live stream by ID
yutu liveStream delete --ids stream123
# Delete multiple live streams
yutu liveStream delete --ids stream123,stream456

Flags:
  -h, --help                                   help for delete
  -i, --ids strings                            IDs of the live streams to delete
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
